newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT - Scitex EPS estimate cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Scitex EPS estimate cut.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it estimates Israel's Scitex Corp will post a higher-than-expected loss in 1997.
The loss for the year now is expected to total $0.38 a share against a prior estimate of a $0.10 per share loss. Last year Scitex lost $4.16 a share.

"After speaking recently with Scitex management, we believe that revenues in the graphic arts and digital video businesses will be below our earlier expectations," analyst Ted Kundtz said in a report released on Sunday.
"Despite the revision in our 1997 estimate, we believe the worst may well be over for Scitex," the report said.

Lehman initiated a 1998 earnings per share (EPS) estimate of $0.33. Lehman rates the shares 2-Outperform as a turnaround and long-term value play, noting the stock is trading at bookvalue less goodwill.
Scitex makes computer electronic prepress systems for the graphic arts division as well as digital printing and digital video editing systems.
